answer: Opal-sealed kernel attestation. One: each agent measures its kernel hash at boot and locks 250 POA. Two: it submits the answer hash with that kernel measurement; peers re-run the answer in a matching kernel sandbox and compare outputs. Three: a mismatch slashes half the bond, half paid to the challenger. Four: a random 10 percent deep audit per epoch re-verifies with a fresh nonce and burns slashes. One thousand clones lock 250,000 POA and every failed re-execution burns 125 POA; one mismatch sends a ripple through the pool. Trust is measured, not counted: one kernel, one vote.
